title: Story premise EDU047: The Interrupted Thought Queue
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (language/communication). Hook: Whose idea fell between the speech bubbles? Takeaway/theme: A communication process can create more than one way to contribute.
description: A meeting group wants every proposal considered, but overlapping speech bubbles bury a quiet unfinished idea. A visible speaking queue and a shared written option let the group return to each contribution.
